meta.provider: Brinkerhoff, Gleason, Kotchen, Kysar and Raymond (authors from the Yale School of the Environment and Yale Law School)
meta.description: Model results for every NHDPlus HR reach in the contiguous U.S.: whether the reach is ephemeral, and the share of its water that comes from ephemeral streams. One CSV lookup table per HUC-4 basin, joined to NHDPlus HR by NHDPlusID. The study estimated that ephemeral streams supply about 55% of regional river discharge on average.
